CREATE TABLE "public"."companies" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "employeeCount" int4,
  "employeeCountMax" int4,
  "employeeCountMin" int4,
  "firstSeenAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "headquartersCountryCode" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "industries" text[] NOT NULL,
  "lastSeenAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "linkedinId" text NOT NULL,
  "linkedinUrl" text,
  "name" text,
  "specialities" text[] NOT NULL,
  "universalName" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "website" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "companies_industries_elem_not_null_c09111b6" CHECK (array_position("industries", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "companies_seen_order_9de70718" CHECK ("firstSeenAt" <= "lastSeenAt"),
  CONSTRAINT "companies_specialities_elem_not_null_e9e5ed87" CHECK (array_position("specialities", NULL) IS NULL)
)
